headline: The job happened on site. The record says otherwise.
You sit down to invoice and can't tell how many hours went into the job.
You're paying for the hours. You're guessing what they went into.

eyebrow: The cost of lost field data
headline: What the crew saw on site is gone before the office can use it.
The site record is built on site, not rebuilt afterwards.
You open the job and it's all there. No phone calls to the crew.
Same job. Different record.
before: Hours and materials rebuilt from memory.
after: Hours, materials and photos logged on the job.

headline: Deliver the job. Keep the record.
